question: What will be the closing value of the CBOE Volatility Index (VIX) (^VIX on Yahoo Finance) on August 29, 2026?
resolution_criteria: Resolves to the daily close of ^VIX on Yahoo Finance for 2026-08-29. If there is no close on that date (weekend or holiday), the last close before it is used.
baseline:
Computed by code from Yahoo Finance daily closes for ^VIX: latest close 14.9000 on 2026-08-07.
Target date 2026-08-29 is 15 trading observations ahead. Percentiles of the price on the target date,
from the empirical distribution of 15-observation returns over the last 3 years (last year weighted double):
p5: 10.5529, p10: 11.7245, p25: 13.3208, p50: 14.793, p75: 16.7951, p90: 19.0764, p95: 20.9277
This ignores news and known events; adjust for them. Check the symbol matches the resolution source
(exchange, contract month, close vs settlement price).
research:
## 1. Resolution source
- The question resolves on the ^VIX daily close on Yahoo Finance. **2026-08-29 is a Saturday**, so the Friday 2026-08-28 close will be used. Counting from 2026-08-10, that is 15 trading days ahead, which matches the code baseline. [Yahoo Finance ^VIX](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/%5EVIX/)
- 2026-08-07: Latest close was **14.90**, down 0.25 from 15.15 on 2026-08-06. The code data, Barchart and a French tracker all show this figure. [YCharts](https://ycharts.com/indicators/vix_volatility_index), [Barchart VIQ26](https://www.barchart.com/stocks/quotes/VIQ26)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has happened yet that settles the question. The VIX is close to its lowest level of 2026, in the mid-teens.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-08: CNBC reported a record week for options trading that helped push the S&P 500 to records. It said the VIX was near its 2026 low, the lowest since January. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/08/record-breaking-week-for-options-powers-sp-500-surge.html)
- 2026-08-07:
  - July payrolls fell by about 23,000, against an expected gain of 88,000. Unemployment was 4.1%.
  - Stocks rallied on bets that the Fed would pause its rate *hike* cycle. The S&P 500 rose 0.6% to a record close and the Nasdaq rose 1.3%, the best week since April.
  - Sources: [Courthouse News](https://www.courthousenews.com/articles/bad-jobs-report-new-iran-peace-tease-keep-markets-rolling), [Tiger](https://www-web.itiger.com/news/1145952581)
- 2026-08-07: The Strait of Hormuz situation was unresolved:
  - Iran's parliamentary committee approved a Hormuz management bill.
  - Iran and Oman had not reached a final deal.
  - Brent was around $82 after a selloff driven by hopes of a deal.
  - This is a live geopolitical tail risk. [Courthouse News](https://courthousenews.com/bad-jobs-report-new-iran-peace-tease-keep-markets-rolling), [Nasdaq/RTT](https://www.nasdaq.com/articles/european-shares-seen-tad-lower-open-hormuz-risks-mount)
- 2026-08-07: August VIX futures (VIQ26) traded around 16.85, about 2 points above spot. That is normal contango and implies the market expects volatility somewhat above the current spot level. [Barchart](https://www.barchart.com/stocks/quotes/VIQ26)
- Context, early August 2026: Commentary argued the VIX looked cheap heading into the seasonally volatile fall of a midterm election year. [Barchart](https://www.barchart.com/story/news/3956689/is-the-vix-inexpensive-going-into-the-historically-volatile-fall-in-2026)

## 4. Base rates
- Code baseline: 15-trading-day percentiles from the 14.90 close, using 3 years of data with the last year weighted double:

| Percentile | VIX level |
|---|---|
| p5 | 10.55 |
| p10 | 11.72 |
| p25 | 13.32 |
| p50 | 14.79 |
| p75 | 16.80 |
| p90 | 19.08 |
| p95 | 20.93 |

- The distribution is skewed upward: spikes are sharp, while declines from a low starting level are limited. The VIX rarely closes below about 11 to 12.
- Seasonality: late August has a history of VIX spikes, for example August 2015, August 2019 and 2024-08-05. Commentators also note that late summer and early fall in midterm years have often been weak for stocks. [Proactive Advisor](https://proactiveadvisormagazine.com/?p=62251)
- Because spot is near its 2026 low, mean reversion would tend to pull it slightly upward, which fits the futures premium.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I could not find a Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market on the VIX close for late August 2026.
- The closest market-based expectation is August VIX futures at about 16.85 on 2026-08-07. They settle on the 2026-08-19 expiration, not on 08-28, and include a risk premium. [Barchart](https://www.barchart.com/stocks/quotes/VIQ26)
- I found no published expert point forecasts.

## 6. Upcoming events before 2026-08-28
- 2026-08-12: July CPI, 8:30 a.m. ET. This matters more than usual because markets were debating whether the Fed would raise rates. [macroornoise](https://macroornoise.com/cpi-release-dates-2026/)
- About 2026-08-19: August VIX futures and options expire, which is normal monthly expiration.
- 2026-08-26, after the close: Nvidia reports Q2 FY2027 results. The date was confirmed on 2026-07-29. This is a major single-stock catalyst for the indices. [Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/company-news/nvidia-schedules-q2-fiscal-2027-earnings-call-for-aug-26-93CH-4821814)
- 2026-08-27 to 08-29: Jackson Hole symposium. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh is scheduled to give the keynote on **2026-08-28 at 10:00 a.m. ET**, the resolution day itself. It is his first Jackson Hole as chair, so policy-signal uncertainty is high. [Kansas City Fed](https://www.kansascityfed.org/newsroom/2026-news-releases/kansas-city-fed-to-host-annual-jackson-hole-economic-policy-symposium-2026/)
- Ongoing: Hormuz and Iran negotiations and oil prices, plus further weak labor data that could revive growth fears.
- The next FOMC meeting is 2026-09-15 to 16, after resolution.
